title: 第五章 一滩烂泥我也要把它拉扯起来第六章 天道羁绊再触动
slug: 种魔得仙第两千三十二章开了
content_zh:

二人一起，朝着黑狱外走去。
“宗门现在，局面十分不妙！”
“不光剑横秋他们背叛了你，我们这一辈的几位师兄师弟师姐师妹，也全带着他们的弟子跑光了，说是担心你死之后，你得罪的那些仇家找上门来。”
“听说这帮狗东西，不光跑了，还把宗门的功法秘术，卷走了极多。”
“都是我被关起来的时候发生的，我也没法拦，是守卫黑狱的一个弟子告诉我的。”
浪三刀飞快道来。
一条条消息，听的赢商脸色直黑下去。
若是这些家伙，都还在宗门里，他的修炼和恢复速度，都将快的多，更有其他玄妙收获。
“不过也好，正好趁这个机会，重塑宗门。”
心念飞转。
赢商和前宗主一样，都是孤狂性子，一心想着修炼的更高，去远方的大天地闯荡，对收徒弟和壮大宗门之事，不太上心，什么牛鬼蛇神，都敢收进宗门里来。
只是，仓促之间，想找几个好徒弟进宗门，没有那么容易。
想到这里，不免头疼。
……
浪三刀瓮声瓮气的声音，在死寂的黑狱里回荡，听起来更加冲击人心。
“赢商，你这如狼似虎的老东西，还没死吗？”
陡然！
一记大喝，从旁边的一见牢房里传来，少年声音，透着偏执的怨恨，听的赢商脚步一停，转头看去。
“里面是谁？”

“大哥你忘了吗？三年前，你为了寻找机缘，破了南边的枭雄冢那处游魂聚居之地，从里面救出了一个孩子出来，这孩子身上阴气极重，你感觉或有可图，就带回了宗来，可惜这小子失忆了，记不得自己是如何去枭雄冢的，和那里又天然亲近，以为那里是他的家，被你灭了，始终不肯拜你为师，还在宗门里惹出不小的是非来。这几年来，你在外游历，我们也不知道拿他怎么办，索性就把他先关进了黑狱里。”
赢商哦然，眼中亮起，露出若有所思的神色来。
“大师伯，是你吗？弟子冤枉啊，切磋比试打伤了对手，怎能算蓄意谋害？”
“大师伯，弟子已经被关了三十年了，再大的罪过，也还的差不多了吧？”
下一刻，一片声音响起。
赢商再愣看去。
旁边的浪三刀喝骂了几句，才尴尬道：“这些弟子，基本上全是脱离宗门的那些狗东西的徒弟，因为种种原因，被关进来的。那些狗东西匆匆离开，自然也不要这帮惹是生非的弟子了。”
“修道资质如何？”
“大多低下，否则也不会被那几个狗东西抛弃，不过也有几个不错，就是性情古怪，爱惹是生非，不服管教。”
赢商微微点头。
再思索了片刻，暂时谁也没有理会，大步走去。
浪三刀连忙跟上，飞快的介绍起那些被关的弟子来，赢商大半时间，要么闭关修炼，要么在外闯荡，还真不全认识这帮小辈。
……
藏经阁，又是一处宗门的重要之地！
乌黑色的九层宝塔样的藏经阁，矗立在一处百花盛开的山谷之中，这里曾经也是弟子往来，守卫森严，热闹又庄严之地。
现在……鬼影也不见一个！
进了藏经阁来，里面空无一人，本来放着一门门功法秘术的架子，更是空空荡荡，有的都倒在了地上，浪三刀已经转过头去，不敢看赢商那张越来越黑的脸。
“好啊，全被卷光了……”
赢商眼中，沉冷肃杀之色，流淌成极寒冰河。
“……驻守藏经阁的首席修士，是季黑石，这个老东西，也是跑掉的修士之一，肯定是他拿了。”

浪三刀硬着头皮说道。
“剑横秋这个小兔崽子，既然有野心接下我们怒火道宗，都不知道拦一拦吗？”
“以剑横秋的实力，是挡不住他们的。”
赢商更气。
弟子不提，那些师弟师妹，不少也是受过他指点的，结果全成了叛徒。人跑了不说，还卷走了宗门的功法秘术，而赢商之前，虽然翻阅过不少，但大多是冰行之道。

The two of them walked towards the outside of the black prison together.
"The situation in our sect is very bad now!"
"Not only did Jian Hengqiu and the others betray you, several of our senior brothers and sisters also ran away with their disciples. They were worried that after your death, the enemies you had offended would come to visit you."
"I heard that these dogs not only ran away, but also took away a lot of the sect's secret techniques."
"It all happened when I was locked up. I couldn't stop it. A disciple guarding the Black Prison told me."
Langsandao came quickly.
Ying Shang's face darkened as he heard the news one after another.
If these guys are still in the sect, his cultivation and recovery speed will be much faster, and he will have other mysterious gains.
"But it's okay, we just take this opportunity to reshape the sect."
Thoughts are racing.
Ying Shang, like his former sect master, has a lonely and crazy temperament. He only thinks about cultivating to a higher level and traveling to distant lands. He doesn't care much about recruiting disciples and strengthening the sect. He dares to accept any kind of monster or snake god into the sect.
However, it is not that easy to find a few good disciples to join the sect in a hurry.
Thinking of this, I can't help but have a headache.
…
The sound of Lang San Dao's urn echoed in the deathly black prison, which sounded even more shocking to people's hearts.
"Ying Shang, you old wolf-like thing is not dead yet?"
Suddenly!
A loud shout came from the nearby prison cell. The young man's voice was full of paranoid resentment. Ying Shang stopped and turned his head to look.
"Who's inside?"
"Brother, have you forgotten? Three years ago, in order to find an opportunity, you broke into the place where wandering souls gather in the Xiongxiong Tomb in the south, and rescued a child from it. This child was very sinister. You felt that there might be something to gain, so you brought Zong Lai back. Unfortunately, this kid lost his memory and couldn't remember who he was. He went to Xiongxiong Tomb and was naturally close to it. He thought it was his home and was destroyed by you. He still refused to accept you as his disciple and caused a lot of trouble in the sect. In the past few years, we didn’t know what to do with him when you were traveling around, so we simply imprisoned him in the dark prison. "
Ying Shang's eyes lit up, looking thoughtful.
"Uncle, is it you? My disciple was wronged. He injured his opponent in a sparring match. How can it be considered intentional murder?"
"Uncle, my disciple has been imprisoned for thirty years. No matter how serious the crime is, it can almost be repaid, right?"
The next moment, a voice sounded.
Yingshang looked blankly again.
Lang Sandao, who was standing next to him, cursed a few times before saying awkwardly: "These disciples are basically the disciples of those idiots who left the sect and were imprisoned for various reasons. Those idiots left in a hurry, so naturally they don't want these troublemaking disciples anymore."
"How are your qualifications for cultivating Taoism?"
"Most of them are low-level, otherwise they wouldn't be abandoned by those bullies, but there are a few that are good, but they have weird personalities, love to cause trouble, and are disobedient to discipline."
Yingshang nodded slightly.
After thinking for a moment, no one paid attention to him for the time being, and he strode away.
Lang Sandao quickly followed up and quickly introduced the imprisoned disciples. Ying Shang spent most of his time either practicing in seclusion or wandering outside. He really didn't know all of these juniors.
…
The Sutra Pavilion is another important place for the sect!
The black nine-story pagoda-like Sutra Pavilion stands in a valley with blooming flowers. It was once a place where disciples came and went, was heavily guarded, lively and solemn.
Now... there is not a single ghost in sight!
When they entered the Sutra Pavilion, there was no one inside. The shelves that originally held various secret techniques were even more empty. Some of them had fallen to the ground. Lang Sandao had already turned his head, not daring to look at Ying Shang's increasingly darker face.
"Okay, it's all swept up..."
In Ying Shang's eyes, the cold and solemn look flowed like an extremely cold glacier.
“…...The chief monk stationed at the Sutra Pavilion is Ji Heishi. This old guy is also one of the monks who ran away. He must have taken it. "
Lang Sandao said bravely.
"Jian Hengqiu, this little brat, since he has ambitions to take over our Angry Dao Sect, doesn't he know how to stop him? "
“With Jian Hengqiu’s strength, he cannot stop them. "
Winning businessmen are even more angry.
Not to mention the disciples, many of those junior brothers and sisters were also mentored by him, but they all turned out to be traitors. Not only did he run away, but he also took away the sect's secret techniques. Although Ying Shang had read a lot before, most of them were about ice walking.
